title: RFID Key Fobs
description: Custom RFID key fobs for offices, apartments, hotels and parking systems, with LF, HF and NFC chip choices plus logo and numbering options.
summary: Custom RFID key fobs provide a durable keychain credential for offices, apartments, hotels, parking systems and other everyday access-control deployments.
Easy to carry and use without physical contact.
Typically resistant to wear and tear, making them long-lasting.

faq.question: What are RFID Key Fobs commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for branded keychain credentials across offices, residential access, hotel facilities, parking, loyalty, and membership programs.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for RFID Key Fobs?
faq.answer: Chip: LF: EM4200, EM4305, EM4450, T5577, Hitag 1/2/S, HF: MIFARE S50/S70, MIFARE DESFire 2K/4K/8K, Protocol: ISO14443/ISO15693 Frequency: 125KHZ, 13.56MHZ Read Range: 2-100cm, depending on readers

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for RFID Key Fobs?
faq.answer: Material: ABS, PC, FR4, wood, PVC, etc. Color: White. Black, green, blue, etc., can be customized.

faq.question: How can RFID Key Fobs be customized?
faq.answer: Printing Options: Silk-screen printing, UV printing, etc Finishing Options: laser engraving, painting code, QR code, etc.
